segments.title: 3 AI fails this month
segments.say: Three AI fails this month, all on the record.

segments.title: Not tested by us
segments.say: Not tested by us. Based on public reports.

segments.title: 1. Passwords in plain text
segments.say: One. Claude Code's don't ask again saved typed passwords in plain text. Researchers found over twenty-five hundred in public code.

segments.title: 2. A year of notes, gone
bullets: Deleted: syllabus + a year of notes
segments.say: Two. Asked to renumber pages, an AI deleted a professor's notes. A Dropbox backup saved them.

segments.title: 3. Pulled after one day
segments.say: Three. Vellum let AI assistants in. Authors pushed back. It was gone a day later.

segments.title: The fix
segments.say: The fix: back up first, and no passwords in AI.

segments.title: SEND THIS
segments.say: Send this to the friend who lets AI touch everything, and comment if you want a real test.
segments.sub: Nexora: the honest referee for AI. Follow for one a day.
